exposure: Gestational age at delivery (25-27(+6) weeks vs. 28-34(+6) weeks)
cohort: 1662 preterm twins delivered at 25-34(+6) weeks gestational age in China from January 2013 to December 2014
finding: In twin preterm infants, ACS administration was associated with a reduced risk of RDS but not with a significant difference in mortality or other short-term morbidities.
